data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: fork
sections.question: fork
sections.summary: a small tool with three or four points used for eating food

senses.definition: a small tool with three or four sharp points that you use to pick up and eat food
examples: She uses a fork to eat her pasta.
He puts the fork next to the plate.

answers.answer: She uses a fork to eat her pasta.
He drinks his fork in the morning.
She wears a fork on her head.
They plant a fork in the garden.
